units.source_text: 源氏回到六条院，心绪不宁，满腹踌躇。

en.t: Genji returned to the Rokujo estate, restless at heart and full of hesitation.

units.source_text: 原来紫姬早已闻知朱雀院欲将三公主嫁与源氏之事，

en.t: As it happened, Lady Murasaki had already heard that the Suzaku Retired Emperor wished to marry the Third Princess to Genji,

units.source_text: 但她想道：“不会有这等事吧。

en.t: but she had thought, "Surely such a thing cannot happen.

units.source_text: 以前他曾经热恋前斋院槿姬，

en.t: In the past, he was once deeply in love with Princess Asagao, the former Kamo priestess,
yet in the end he never tried to force her into marriage."

units.source_text: 所以她很放心，从来不曾向源氏探问有否此事。

en.t: So she felt quite reassured and had never questioned Genji about whether there was any truth to the matter.

units.source_text: 因此源氏心中颇觉怜恤。

en.t: For that reason, Genji felt a deep pity for her in his heart.

units.source_text: 他想：“紫姬倘知道了今天的事，不知作何感想。

en.t: He thought, "If Lady Murasaki learns what happened today, I wonder what she will think.

units.source_text: 其实我对她的爱情，丝毫不会变更。

en.t: In truth, my love for her will not change in the slightest.

units.source_text: 有了此事，我爱她一定反而更深。

en.t: Because of this matter, I am certain I will love her even more deeply.

units.source_text: 只是在尚未见诸事实以前，不知她将何等怀疑于我！”

en.t: But before this has taken visible form, how terribly she may come to doubt me!"

units.source_text: 这两人相处到了这年龄，

en.t: By this age, the two of them had lived together for so long

units.source_text: 已经彼此毫无隔阂，成了一对亲睦的伴侣。

en.t: that there was already no distance between them at all, and they had become a deeply intimate pair of companions.

units.source_text: 所以心中略有一点隐情，便觉异常不快。

en.t: Therefore, even the slightest hidden feeling in his heart made him feel unusually distressed.

units.source_text: 但当夜立即就寝，一宿无话。

en.t: But that night they went to bed at once, and the night passed without incident.
